Performance card. The slowest page is rarely the home page. Bar chart: / 320 ms, /pricing 410 ms, /blog 1,240 ms, /contact 380 ms. Example analysis, response time per page. Try this: List your five most visited pages from analytics and time each one. Fix the slowest first.

Accessibility card. Contrast is math, not taste. 4.5 : 1, Minimum contrast for body text, WCAG 2.2 AA. Try this: Check your muted text colour against its background in DevTools. The colour picker shows the ratio.

Analytics card. Tag campaign links the same way, every time. Code: ?utm_source=linkedin &utm_medium=social &utm_campaign=launch-2026-10. Lowercase, no spaces, one naming sheet. Try this: Make a shared sheet with the allowed sources and mediums. Link it from every campaign brief.

Security card. Stop browsers guessing file types. Code: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Pairs well with correct Content-Type headers. Try this: Add it next to HSTS in the same rule, so both ship together.

Accessibility card. Every input needs a name. Placeholder only (fail): <input placeholder="Email">. Labelled (pass): <label for="email">Email</label>, <input id="email">. Try this: Tab through your contact form with a screen reader on. Each field should say what it is.

GEO, AI search card. llms.txt: a short brief for answer engines. Code: # Example Co > What we do, in one sentence. ## Pages - [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing) - [Docs](https://example.com/docs). Served as /llms.txt.

Accessibility card. Put the mouse away. Can you reach everything? Checklist: Tab reaches the menu, Visible focus ring (pass); Dialog opens, Focus moves inside (pass); Escape, Closes the dialog (warning); Cookie banner, Reachable before the page (warning).

Security card. One header. 180 days of HTTPS only. Code: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=15552000. 15,552,000 seconds = 180 days. Try this: Run curl -sI on your domain and look for strict-transport-security. If it is missing, add it at your host or CDN.
